**Finding submitted — deviation (LOL-CAP), Section 14.5 (p0602).**

- **What the document does:** Section 14.5 is the only limitation-of-liability provision (Article XIV is otherwise indemnity/mitigation/insurance; 14.6 expressly says insurance is no liability limit; 15.6(a) only bars punitive awards in arbitration). It gives a mutual waiver of special/consequential/incidental/punitive/indirect damages and lost profits, but **no aggregate monetary cap at all** — direct liability is unlimited for both parties.
- **Why it fails fallback:** no mutual aggregate cap and no 12-months-of-fees basis. Gross negligence and willful misconduct were also not carved out.
- **Already met:** the existing "NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 14.5 ... SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE INDEMNIFICATION RIGHTS OR OBLIGATIONS ... OR DAMAGES ... RELATING TO CONFIDENTIALITY UNDER ARTICLE XI" sentence keeps indemnification and confidentiality outside anything in Section 14.5, including the new cap.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** one inserted sentence within Section 14.5 setting a mutual cap at amounts paid or payable by Sanofi in the twelve months preceding the claim, subject to the existing carve-outs and with gross negligence/willful misconduct uncapped. Fallback target only — no USD 1,000,000 floor, data-protection, fraud or payment-obligation extras added.
